name: Mini Golf Game
summary:
Welcome to our Mini Golf Game for VR !
This was an experimental game developed by Western Kentucky University Extended Reality Lab. We hope you like it and if you would like to give us some feedback please send us an email at: wku.xr.headset@gmail.com

This app does not intend to recreate or simulate the realistic behavior of playing golf. Our only intention is to provide a fun and immersive entertainment to our players.
